headline: Your invitation to [[org_name]]
intro: [[inviter_name]] invited you to the [[org_name]] workspace on [[app_name]].
note: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
subject: Your invitation to [[org_name]]

headline: Reset your password
intro: Hi [[name]], we received a request to reset your [[app_name]] password. Use the link below to choose a new one.
note: If you did not request this, ignore this email. Your password has not changed.
subject: Reset your password

headline: Your [[app_name]] workspace
intro: Hi [[name]], welcome to [[app_name]]. Bring your people, knowledge and agents together in one workspace.
note: Start with one task and review the result.
subject: Your [[app_name]] workspace

headline: Verify your email address
intro: Hi [[name]], confirm this email address to finish verifying your [[app_name]] account.
note: If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
subject: Verify your email address

headline: Sign in to [[app_name]]
intro: Hi [[name]], use this link to sign in to your [[app_name]] account.
note: If you did not request this link, you can ignore this email.
subject: Sign in to [[app_name]]

headline: Confirm your new email
intro: Hi [[name]], confirm this email address to complete the change on your [[app_name]] account.
note: If you did not request this change, do not use this link.
preview: Confirm the new email address for your [[app_name]] account
subject: Confirm your new email

headline: Email change requested
intro: Hi [[name]], someone requested a change to the email address on your [[app_name]] account. The new address must be verified before the change is completed.
note: If this was not you, contact your administrator immediately.
preview: A change to your [[app_name]] email address was requested
subject: Email change requested

headline: Administrator access started
intro: Hi [[name]], an administrator started an impersonation session for your [[app_name]] account.
note: If this access was unexpected, contact your administrator.
preview: An administrator started an account access session
subject: Administrator access started

headline: [[agent_name]] needs approval
intro: Review the requested tool use before this run continues.
note: The run stays on hold until an authorized approver makes a decision.
preview: Review the tool use requested by [[agent_name]]
subject: [[agent_name]] needs approval

headline: [[agent_name]] is awaiting approval
intro: An authorized approver needs to review the tool use requested for this run.
note: This is a status update. There is no approval action to take from this email.
preview: [[agent_name]] is waiting for an approval decision
subject: [[agent_name]] is awaiting approval

headline: Budget limit reached
intro: [[agent_name]] stopped at its budget limit in [[org_name]].
note: Review the run and its usage before deciding what to do next.
subject: Budget limit reached

headline: Agent usage for [[org_name]]
intro: Your usage summary for this [[period]].
note: Open the dashboard for the activity behind these totals.
subject: Agent usage for [[org_name]]

headline: Workspace update
intro: There is an update for you in [[app_name]].
note: Open the update for its full context.
subject: Workspace update

headline: Payment received
intro: Hi [[name]], your payment for the [[plan_name]] plan on [[app_name]] was successful.
note: Keep your invoice for your records.
subject: Payment received

headline: Payment failed
intro: Hi [[name]], we could not process your latest [[app_name]] payment. Check your payment details and update them if needed.
note: If you already updated your details, check your billing account for the latest status.
preview: Check the payment details for your [[app_name]] account
subject: Payment failed

headline: Subscription updated
intro: Hi [[name]], your [[app_name]] subscription has been updated.
note: Review your subscription details in the billing portal.
subject: Subscription updated

headline: Subscription canceled
intro: Hi [[name]], your [[plan_name]] subscription on [[app_name]] has been canceled.
preview: Your subscription is canceled; access continues until [[access_until]]
subject: Subscription canceled

headline: Your trial is ending
intro: Hi [[name]], your [[app_name]] trial is nearly over. Choose a plan to continue.
subject: Your trial is ending

headline: Your trial has ended
intro: Hi [[name]], your [[app_name]] trial has ended. Choose a plan when you are ready to continue.
subject: Your trial has ended

headline: Credit balance running low
intro: Hi [[name]], your [[app_name]] credit balance is running low. Add credits to keep your work moving.
note: Review your balance and choose the amount you need.
preview: Your [[app_name]] credit balance is running low
subject: Credit balance running low

headline: You are subscribed to [[app_name]] updates
intro: You will receive product news and updates about working with your agents.
preview: Your subscription to [[app_name]] updates is confirmed
subject: You are subscribed to [[app_name]] updates
